Turbines: U.S. Wind Turbine Database v9.1, Nolan and Taylor counties. Elevation: USGS 3DEP. Line of sight from eye height (5.6 ft) to blade tip within 25 miles, bare earth, with earth curvature and refraction. Trees and buildings that block views are not modeled. Distance bands for a selected turbine: conservative thresholds from field observations of similar turbines in Wyoming and Colorado (Sullivan et al. 2012, Argonne National Laboratory).
